scripts.build:preview: rm -rf dist && bun run generate:cn && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview vp build --mode preview && bun scripts/verify-build.ts preview && bun scripts/optimize-prerendered-html.ts
scripts.build:production: rm -rf dist && bun run generate:cn && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vp build --mode production && bun scripts/verify-build.ts production && bun scripts/optimize-prerendered-html.ts
scripts.build:test: rm -rf dist && bun run generate:cn && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=test vp build --mode test && bun scripts/verify-build.ts test && bun scripts/optimize-prerendered-html.ts
scripts.cf-typegen: vp exec wrangler types --env development src/types/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.check: bun run generate:cn && bun run check:i18n && vp check
scripts.check:fix: bun run generate:cn && bun run check:i18n && vp check --fix
scripts.check:pre-commit: bun run generate:cn && bun run check:i18n && vp staged
scripts.clean: rm -rf .source .tanstack .wrangler dist coverage playwright-report test-results blob-report *.tsbuildinfo
scripts.clean:hardcore: bun run clean:deep && rm -rf bun.lock skills-lock.json
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run build:preview && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json && bun scripts/verify-deployment.ts preview
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build:production && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json && bun scripts/verify-deployment.ts production
scripts.dev: bun run generate:cn && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=development vp dev
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.typegen: bun run cf-typegen && bun run generate:cn
